CAF.note: Finance ministry, not the central bank, is the actor; no central bank role stated.
Nothing on consumer rules or redress.
Names Sydonia World only as to be interconnected with banks for payment; no statement on declarations processing.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Only an ENERCA-Orange bill payment partnership, no mobile money service status stated.

facts.fact: The finance ministry and commercial bank heads discussed making operational the e-Tax tele-payment module for digital tax payment and the launch of digital customs payment after Sydonia World was interconnected with banks' systems.
From 27 January 2025 the finance ministry ran an information and training campaign for tax and customs agents and taxpayers on the e-Tax tool, with EU-funded support.
